card.name: Just before renin-angiotensin system mentions
card.fires_on: Small words or word parts right before 'renin-angiotensin', such as 'of' or 'the' after 'activity', and 'inhib-iting' before 'parts of the renin-angiotensin'. Seen in ACE inhibitor and ARB label warnings.

modes.label: Renal function dependence
modes.description: 'of' or 'the' after 'activity' in the phrase about renal function depending on renin-angiotensin system activity.
modes.example: In patients with severe congestive heart failure, whose renal function may depend on the activity<< of>> the renin-angiotensin

modes.label: Inhibiting parts of the system
modes.description: The 'iting' ending of 'inhibiting' in the phrase about lowering blood pressure by inhibiting parts of the renin-angiotensin system.
modes.example: presumably because drugs of both classes lower blood pressure by inhib<<iting>> parts of the renin-angiot
